title: SpatialCraft: Evolving Procedural Intelligence from Experience and Skills for Spatial Reasoning Agents
abstract: arXiv:2611.31475v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Spatial reasoning agents increasingly rely on external tools, such as 3D reconstruction, segmentation, and geometric computation, to answer questions that a multimodal large language model (MLLM) cannot resolve from pixels alone. Tool access, however, shifts the bottleneck to orchestration: the agent must decide which tools to call, in what order, and how to interpret their outputs, yet a stateless agent repeats the same mistakes across tasks. We ask whether a frozen tool-using agent can improve its orchestration from its own interaction history, without parameter updates. We present SpatialCraft, a self-evolving framework that maintains two forms of external knowledge: Experiences, condition-action tactics distilled by contrasting rollouts of the same task, and Skills, multi-step procedures with explicit activation and termination conditions. translated_title: SpatialCraft：从经验与技能中演化程序性智能的空间推理智能体
translated_abstract: 空间推理智能体越来越依赖外部工具（如3D重建、分割和几何计算）来回答多模态大语言模型（MLLM）仅凭像素无法解决的问题。然而，工具的使用将瓶颈转移到了编排（orchestration）环节：智能体必须决定调用哪些工具、以何种顺序调用，以及如何解释工具的输出，而无状态的智能体会在不同任务中重复相同的错误。我们探讨一个参数冻结的工具使用智能体能否在不更新参数的情况下，从自身的交互历史中改进其编排能力。我们提出SpatialCraft，一个自演化框架，它维护两种形式的外部知识：经验——通过对比同一任务的不同执行轨迹提炼出的“条件-动作”策略；以及技能——具有明确激活条件和终止条件的多步骤程序。三种设计将这两个知识流相互耦合，经验可以锚定到某个技能之上，仅在……
tldr: SpatialCraft提出一个无需参数更新的自演化框架，让冻结的工具调用智能体通过积累“经验”（条件-动作策略）和“技能”（带激活与终止条件的多步骤程序）两类外部知识，从自身交互历史中不断改进工具编排能力。
en_tdlr: SpatialCraft is a self-evolving framework that enables a frozen tool-using agent to improve its tool orchestration from its own interaction history, without parameter updates, by maintaining two forms of external knowledge: Experiences (condition-action tactics) and Skills (multi-step procedures with explicit activation and termination conditions).
